Ask: please reply with a single-line vote (endorse / borderline / decline) and a one-sentence rationale. If you can, drop your numeric score in the shared scorecard (attached) and paste HubSpot ID HS-4421 in your reply. We need a final call by EOD PT.

Subject: Re: Final technical debrief — Priya Nair (SWE-3) — score merge & closure

Ben —

Endorse. Score: 7/10 (logged in HS-4421).

Notes (quick): coding pair was competent — completed prompt and handled most edge cases, but missed a small race condition in follow-up which I called out during Q&A. System design: good pattern familiarity but lacked depth on scaling tradeoffs for multi-tenant KV workloads; asked a few surface-level questions but didn't drive deeper constraints. Communication and ownership strong.

Recommendation: I would move forward but recommend a light design follow-up (15–20m) with a senior infra engineer if we advance to offer stage.

Attached: laura_notes_priya.pdf with line-by-line highlights.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses. Pulling together final synth:

- Votes: Aditya = endorse (8), Laura = endorse (7), Rishi = borderline (5).
- Net: lean hire but with an explicit follow-up ask.

Marissa — can you make the tiebreak/closure call? My recommendation is: move to phone-level offer conversation contingent on a 20-minute targeted design check (with Rishi or a senior infra engineer) to validate the gaps Rishi flagged. If that check fails, we close out as decline. If it passes, proceed to offer.

Please update HS-4421 and confirm by EOD PT (17:00). If we agree, Sophie, please hold off on extending any timelines to Priya until we complete the targeted check and confirm. Priya — thanks for your time yesterday; we may reach out for a brief follow-up conversation if we proceed.
